sources.title: Artemis II SLS Reference Guide (2026)
limitations: Rounded reference specifications are not a time-varying mass/thrust model.
Does not by itself provide full high-rate flight-state telemetry or all aero/GNC parameters.

sources.title: Artemis II Press Kit - ascent and mission timeline
use_for: TLI by Orion service-module main engine
limitations: The page states timeline times can change; planned times must not be mislabeled as actual measured event times.

sources.title: Artemis II Launch Day Updates (April 1, 2026)
use_for: publicly reported stage separation and initial operations
limitations: Public event summaries do not contain the complete high-rate truth state, propulsion telemetry or full guidance history. Preserve stated time precision.

sources.title: Artemis II Flight Day 2: Orion Completes TLI Burn, Crew Begins Journey to the Moon
use_for: fact that Orion performed the TLI burn
limitations: Published event/summary values are not a full 6-DOF telemetry history or the complete maneuver direction vector.

sources.title: Artemis II Flight Day 2: Crew, Houston Poll 'Go' for Translunar Injection Burn
use_for: planned/authorized TLI start time and burn plan
limitations: Use the completion report for the completed maneuver; do not confuse planned and completed statuses.

sources.title: Space Launch System
use_for: SLS Block 1 versus Block 1B configuration distinction
limitations: High-level program summary, not a complete propulsion model.

sources.title: Space Launch System Block 1 3D model
use_for: starting point for SLS Block 1 geometry and visual reconstruction
limitations: Verify supplied model dimensions, coordinate axes, materials, format, asset-specific credit/usage guidance and differences from the Artemis II flight markings before calling it an Artemis II-specific exact model.

sources.title: Orion Capsule 3D resources
use_for: crew-module visual model or reference geometry
limitations: A crew-module STL alone is not a complete Orion plus European Service Module and solar-array model; align scale/origin and review asset use guidance.

sources.title: NASA 3D Resources
use_for: searching permitted NASA geometry, texture and supporting models
limitations: Follow the page's usage guidance and any asset-specific credit/provenance requirements. NASA insignia/endorsement rules remain applicable.

sources.title: General Mission Analysis Tool (GMAT) Version R2026
use_for: independent orbital propagation and maneuver comparisons
limitations: GMAT agreement checks only the matched orbital model/inputs. It does not prove the SLS propulsion, low-altitude aero, staging or structural/ground-ops models are correct.

sources.title: JPL Horizons API documentation
use_for: Moon/Earth/planetary reference ephemerides and geometric checks where the query target/center/frame are supported
limitations: A planetary ephemeris is not Artemis II spacecraft telemetry. A query must explicitly define target, center, epoch, frame, time scale, units and quantity.

sources.title: Introduction to SPICE and SPICE kernels
use_for: kernel-based ephemerides, frame/time utilities and reproducible geometry calculations when suitable kernels exist
limitations: Confirm the needed kernels, target coverage and licensing/usage notes are actually available. Do not imply an Artemis II spacecraft SPK is present unless obtained and verified.

sources.title: SimuPy Flight Vehicle Toolkit and NESC test cases
use_for: evaluating independently tested generic flight equations and NESC 6-DOF test cases
possible reference implementation for later six-degree-of-freedom dynamics
limitations: This is not an SLS vehicle model. Its generic test cases validate selected equation implementations, not Artemis II flight parameters or vehicle fidelity.

sources.title: Basilisk astrodynamics simulation framework
use_for: optional attitude/GNC and spacecraft dynamics cross-checks if a supported model and installed version fit
limitations: Not required for the first AIM 1 ascent model and not an SLS propulsion/staging solver.

sources.title: OpenMDAO Dymos documentation
use_for: optional future trajectory/guidance optimization when a well-defined objective and constraints are required
limitations: Optimization is not a replacement for correct force data or independent model validation; not required for Gate 1 or the first ascent prototype.
